title: IELTS PREPARATION COURSE
overview: This intensive, skills-based preparation course develops the English-language abilities and test strategies required for the International English Language Testing System (IELTS). Participants practise Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking through guided tasks, timed exercises, targeted feedback and realistic mock assessments. The course introduces the Academic and General Training pathways and tailors relevant Reading and Writing practice to the selected test format. Emphasis is placed on accurate communication, task fulfilment, time management and independent improvement; achievement of a particular band score is not guaranteed.
audience: Students applying to universities or academic institutions; professionals seeking English-language evidence for employment, licensing or professional development; individuals preparing for migration-related language requirements; and learners who wish to improve their performance in the IELTS examination. Participants should have a functional foundation in English and undertake a diagnostic assessment to establish their starting level.
methodology: Instructor-led language workshops; diagnostic testing; model-answer analysis; guided listening and reading practice; structured writing tasks; paired speaking interviews; pronunciation and vocabulary drills; timed section exercises; peer review; individualized feedback; progress checks; and full or sectional mock tests with improvement planning.
competencies: IELTS test literacy and selection of the appropriate Academic or General Training pathway
Effective comprehension of spoken English across varied accents and contexts
Efficient reading for main ideas, details, inference and writer purpose
Clear, well-organized writing that meets task requirements
Fluent and coherent spoken interaction with appropriate pronunciation
Accurate grammatical structures and topic-appropriate vocabulary
Time management, answer checking and self-correction under exam conditions
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the IELTS test structure, scoring criteria and differences between the two test pathways.
Apply focused listening techniques to identify key information and avoid common distractors.
Use skimming, scanning and evidence-based reasoning to complete reading tasks efficiently.
Plan and produce responses for Writing Task 1 and Task 2 according to the selected test format.
Demonstrate clear, extended and relevant answers across the three parts of the Speaking test.
Improve grammatical range, lexical precision, cohesion and pronunciation through targeted practice.
Complete timed practice tests, interpret feedback and establish a personal revision strategy.
